description: 行李没出来时，快速报失、描述特征、确认送达和赔偿，不让旅程被一个箱子拖垮。

targetChunks.en: My suitcase didn't come out on the belt.
targetChunks.zh: 我的行李箱没从传送带出来。
targetChunks.note: belt = 行李传送带；说清事实再报失。
targetChunks.exampleEn: My suitcase didn't come out on the belt.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我的行李箱没从传送带出来。

targetChunks.en: I'd like to file a missing baggage report.
targetChunks.note: file a report = 正式登记，机场标准说法。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'd like to file a missing baggage report.

targetChunks.en: It's a black hard-shell case with a red tag.
targetChunks.zh: 是个黑色硬壳箱，挂着红色标签。
targetChunks.note: 描述颜色、材质、特征，方便对方查找。
targetChunks.exampleEn: It's a black hard-shell case with a red tag.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 是个黑色硬壳箱，挂着红色标签。

targetChunks.en: I have the baggage claim tag.
targetChunks.note: claim tag 是取行李的凭证，报失时必备。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I have the baggage claim tag right here.

targetChunks.en: When can I expect it to be delivered?
targetChunks.note: expect it to be delivered = 预计送达，比 When will it come 正式。
targetChunks.exampleEn: When can I expect it to be delivered?

targetChunks.note: 说明时间压力，促使对方优先处理。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'm here for three days, so timing really matters.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我在这里待三天，时间很关键。

targetChunks.en: I need a few essentials tonight.
targetChunks.zh: 我今晚需要一些必需品。
targetChunks.note: essentials = 必需品；可据此申请临时补偿。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I need a few essentials tonight.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我今晚需要一些必需品。

targetChunks.zh: 你们的赔偿政策是什么？
targetChunks.note: 问政策，不先要钱，显得理性。
targetChunks.exampleEn: What's your compensation policy for delayed bags?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 行李延误的赔偿政策是什么？

targetChunks.en: Could you deliver it to my hotel?
targetChunks.note: deliver to + 地点；确认送达地址和联系人。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Could you deliver it to my hotel?

targetChunks.en: Can I get a reference number?
targetChunks.zh: 能给我一个查询编号吗？
targetChunks.note: reference number 是后续追踪和理赔的关键。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Can I get a reference number for the claim?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 能给我一个理赔查询编号吗？

targetChunks.en: I'll keep my receipts, just in case.
targetChunks.zh: 我会留好收据，以防万一。
targetChunks.note: just in case = 以防万一；临时购买的收据可报销。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'll keep my receipts, just in case.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我会留好收据，以防万一。

roleplay.promptZh: 到达后行李没出来。你要报失、描述箱子、确认送达时间和酒店地址，并问清临时补偿。
roleplay.promptEn: Your bag didn't arrive. File a report, describe the case, confirm delivery to your hotel, and ask about interim compensation.
goals: 说清行李特征和行李牌
问清临时补偿与查询编号
